name: runs-on/action
description: RunsOn Action for magic caching, and more

show_costs.description: Control how execution costs are displayed: "inline" for log output, "summary" for GitHub job summary, any other value disables the feature

metrics.description: Comma separated list of additional metrics to send to CloudWatch (cpu, network, memory, disk, io)

sccache.description: Enable sccache. Can take either "s3" (RunsOn S3 cache bucket) or be empty (disabled). You still need to setup sccache in your workflow, for instance with mozill
